title: easily damaged
text:
easily damaged. when defrosting the freezer, which is necessary every 2 weeks, a coil for the thermostat came off with the sheet of ice, and now the "warmest" thermostat setting is almost freezing. if i turn the thermostat only 2 notches colder, every beverage is turned to ice.

if you buy this product, be super cautious on the defrosting.
